user.title: Connect to Watercare
user.description: Sign in with your Watercare account. Mechanical (monthly-read) meters are supported. Costs are calculated from Watercare's published prices for each financial year.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Watercare app or My Account.
data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Watercare again
reauth_confirm.description: Watercare no longer accepts the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.

reconfigure.title: Update the Watercare sign-in
reconfigure.description: Change the email or password for this Watercare account. The account itself cannot be changed here; to switch accounts, remove Watercare and add it again.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Watercare app or My Account.
data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.

error.invalid_auth: Watercare rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Watercare. Try again shortly.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Watercare account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Watercare account. Only one account can be added, so to switch accounts, remove Watercare and add it again.

init.title: Watercare prices
init.description: Prices for bills that start in the {financial_year} financial year, including GST, pre-filled from Watercare's published price schedule or from your own earlier entry. Change them only if your bill shows different prices. Earlier years always use the published prices, and a change never reprices days that are already recorded.

data_description.wastewater_ratio: Share of metered water billed as wastewater. Shown on the bill as, for example, '@78.50%', entered here as 0.785. Most homes are 0.785 and apartments 0.95.
data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

new_year.title: Watercare prices
new_year.description: This version of the integration does not know Watercare's prices for the {financial_year} financial year, so cost statistics pause at the first bill that starts on or after 1 July. Enter all three prices from a bill that starts in {financial_year} (including GST), or leave them empty to keep waiting for a release that includes them. Prices never reprice days that are already recorded.

data_description.wastewater_ratio: Share of metered water billed as wastewater. Shown on the bill as, for example, '@78.50%', entered here as 0.785. Most homes are 0.785 and apartments 0.95.
data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

error.incomplete_prices: Enter all three prices, or leave all three empty.

cannot_connect.message: Could not get data from Watercare: {error}

unexpected_response.message: Watercare returned billing data in an unexpected format.

no_billing_periods.message: Watercare returned no completed billing periods.

missing_credentials.message: The Watercare config entry has no email or password. Remove it and add the integration again.

init.title: Watercare prices for {financial_year}
init.description: Watercare changes its prices every 1 July and charges each bill at the prices in force when its billing period starts. This version of the integration does not know the {financial_year} prices yet, so water cost statistics are paused from the first bill that starts in {financial_year}; usage is still recorded. Copy the prices from that bill, or update the integration once a release includes them. Prices entered here never reprice days that are already recorded.

data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

abort.entry_not_found: The Watercare config entry no longer exists.

statistics_rebuild_skipped.title: Watercare statistics were not rebuilt
statistics_rebuild_skipped.description: Version 1.5.0 records water use as daily rows, each bill priced at the tariff in force when it started. It did not rebuild the stored Watercare statistics because they reach back further than the bills Watercare now returns, and a rebuild would lose that history. New days are added after the stored history. See the statistics documentation for a manual rebuild.
